en-US.title: [Part 1] Hot spots for a great photo opportunity! Top 5 fantastic domestic travel destinations 🔥🔥
en-US.description:
I've selected my top five spots from my three-month trip around Korea!
Looking at all of them, I realize there are so many beautiful places in Korea, even without going abroad!

00:00 3rd Place: The starting point of the Han River! Taebaek, Gangwon-do [Geomryongso]
Link to main video: https://youtu.be/LC5CqEeqOZA
Location: Entrance to Geomryongso Free Parking Lot / 146-4 Changjuk-dong, Taebaek-si, Gangwon-do
Park in the parking lot and trek for about an hour.

01:07 4th Place: Seoul's Eternal Landmark [Namsan]
Link to main video: https://youtu.be/VtcYLY9alX8
Location: Namsan Tower Cable Car Address: 83, Sopa-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul, Republic of Korea
Adults: 14,000 won round trip, 11,000 won one way (elementary school students and older)
Children: 10,500 won round trip, 8,000 won one way

02:22 5th Place: Yeongwol, Gangwon-do, where Kim Satgat lived [Dark Village]

Link to main video: https://youtu.be/70Pqo7kegNw
Location: 216-24 Kimsatgat-ro, Kimsatgat-myeon, Yeongwol-gun, Gangwon-do
Park at the Nango Kimsatgat Literature Museum parking lot and hike for about an hour.

03:08 2nd Place: One of Korea's Top 5 Silver Grass Fields, Jeongseon, Gangwon-do [Mindungsan]
Link to main story: https://youtu.be/OiysGdyboRQ
Location: Public parking lot near Mindungsan Stadium / 784-9 Mureung-ri, Nam-myeon, Jeongseon-gun, Gangwon-do
How to get to the summit of Mindungsan
About a 2-hour hike from the hiking trail visible across from the entrance to Jeungsan Elementary School.

04:34 1st Place: A great shot, even if you just take it! Samcheok, Gangwon-do [Miin Falls]
Link to original video: https://youtu.be/xpx8zmXKaa4
Location: Samcheok Yeoraesa Temple Parking Lot / 77-162 Munuijae-ro, Dogye-eup, Samcheok-si, Gangwon-do
Park in the parking lot and walk down the stairs for about 15 minutes to reach the falls.

There are those who have never seen it, but no one has seen it only once.
